title: 18 Days
tagline: Birding, Wildlife, Culture & Adventure — with a Summer Holiday
summary: The complete traverse of Sri Lanka's wild and cultural heart: dry-zone national parks, ancient cities, hill-country tea trails, the Ella train, and Sinharaja rainforest, closing with a highland beach finish.
highlights: Wilpattu National Park — leopard, sloth bear, elephant
Ancient city tour of Anuradhapura and Mihintale Temple
Trincomalee: Pigeon Island and dolphin watching
Sigiriya Lion Rock, Pidurangala, Polonnaruwa, Minneriya
Kandy's Temple of the Tooth and tea country
White-water rafting, canyoning and zip-lining at Kithulgala
The Ella train, Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam's Peak
Sinharaja Rain Forest birding, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

itinerary.title: Arrival & Dutch Canal Boat Trip
itinerary.description: Arrive at Colombo airport and drive to Negombo (approximately half an hour).

itinerary.title: Wilpattu & the Ancient City
itinerary.description: Negombo fish market, Wilpattu National Park, an Anuradhapura ancient city tour, and Mihintale Temple. Wilpattu is Sri Lanka's largest national park, known for leopard, sloth bear, elephant, its natural lakes (villus), and dry-zone birdlife.

itinerary.title: Coast, Reef & Dolphins
itinerary.description: Trincomalee city tour, Pigeon Island, and dolphin watching.

itinerary.title: Lion Rock & Ancient Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Lion Rock Fortress, Pidurangala Temple, a Polonnaruwa ancient city tour, an optional village tour, and Minneriya National Park.

itinerary.title: Temple, Tea & Culture
itinerary.description: Dambulla Cave Temple, a herb and spice garden, a Kandy cultural show, the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a tea factory visit, and a Kandy city tour.

itinerary.title: Rail to the Highlands & Adventure Sports
itinerary.description: Train trip toward Nuwara Eliya, birding and a nature walk, plus adventure sports — white-water rafting, canyoning, and zip-lining.

itinerary.title: The Ella Train & Hill Country Trails
itinerary.description: Train trip to Ella, the Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Waterfall, and Nildiya Pokuna, with Ella Rock and zip-lining available as optional add-ons.

itinerary.title: Yala Safari
itinerary.description: A full day safari in Yala National Park.

itinerary.title: Rainforest Birding
itinerary.description: Birding and a nature walk through Sinharaja Rain Forest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Sri Lanka's richest lowland rainforest for endemic species.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for departure.
itinerary.note: Exact departure-day logistics to be confirmed with Nandana.

title: Two Weeks
tagline: Bird Watching, Wildlife & Culture Attraction Tour
summary: The island end to end at a birder's pace: the ancient cities and Sigiriya, Kandy and the Udawatta Kele forest, Kithulgala's rainforest, the Nuwara Eliya highlands and Horton Plains, then four dry-zone parks in a row — Yala, Bundala, Udawalawe — before Sinharaja and a last day at Mirissa.
highlights: Minneriya National Park and dawn birding around Sigiriya
Sigiriya Lion Rock and the medieval capital of Polonnaruwa
Dambulla Cave Temple and Kandy's Temple of the Tooth
Udawatta Kele forest owls and Kithulgala's Kelani River
Victoria Park, Nuwara Eliya and Horton Plains cloud forest
Yala National Park — leopard and sloth bear
Bundala Ramsar wetland waders and flamingos
Udawalawe's elephant herds at close range
Sinharaja Rain Forest — a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Mirissa Beach and blue whale watching

itinerary.title: Arrival & Minneriya National Park
itinerary.description: Arrive at Colombo airport and drive to Sigiriya (about three and a half hours). Afternoon birding and a wildlife safari drive at Minneriya National Park. Overnight at Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Dawn Birding, Lion Rock & the Medieval Capital
itinerary.description: Early morning birding around Sigiriya. After breakfast, climb Sigiriya rock — a giant rock fortress, with the frescoes of the heavenly maidens halfway up and a view over the whole surrounding plain from the summit. Afternoon visit to the Polonnaruwa ancient city, the country's medieval capital from the 10th to the 11th century AD, with its palace buildings and public halls, shrines, temples, pagodas and granite sculpture. Overnight at Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Dambulla, Spice Garden & the Temple of the Tooth
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Kandy. En route, visit the Dambulla cave temple and a spice garden, and in the afternoon the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Overnight at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Forest Owls & the Kelani River
itinerary.description: Early morning birding at Udawatta Kele forest, then after breakfast drive to Kithulgala. Crossing the beautiful Kelani River takes you into high-density rainforest; the village is surrounded by forest attracting many species of birds, and the river itself is famous for white-water rafting. Overnight at Kithulgala.

itinerary.title: Victoria Park
itinerary.description: A small park located in the centre of Nuwara Eliya, and one of the most reliable places in the country for wintering highland migrants. Overnight at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Mountain & Cloud Forest
itinerary.description: A day in Horton Plains' montane and cloud forest habitat. Overnight at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: En Route Birding & the Water Tanks
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Tissamaharama, stopping en route for short birding at a bird sanctuary. Afternoon birding around the water tanks in Tissamaharama. Overnight at Tissamaharama.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Safari
itinerary.description: Yala National Park sits in the dry zone and holds a diversity of habitats — scrub jungle, water reservoirs, brackish lagoons and riverine forest. It is the best park in the country to see leopard and sloth bear. Overnight at Tissamaharama.
highlights: Elephant, leopard, sloth bear, spotted deer, sambar, wild boar, grey langur, marsh & mugger crocodile

itinerary.title: The Bundala Ramsar Wetland
itinerary.description: Bundala borders the sea and is made up of scrub jungle and salt pans — a very good area to watch water birds and migrant waders during the northern winter. Overnight at Udawalawe.
highlights: Great Crested, Lesser Crested, Caspian, Gull-billed & Little Terns

itinerary.title: Elephants at Close Range
itinerary.description: Early morning safari drive at Udawalawe National Park, then on to Sinharaja. Udawalawe sits in the dry zone and comprises scrub jungle, grassland, water reservoirs and riverine habitats — the best park in the country for watching herds of wild elephants at close range. Overnight at Sinharaja.

itinerary.title: Lowland Rainforest Birding
itinerary.description: Two days birding in Sinharaja Rain Forest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site holding the richest biodiversity in Asia and home to most of Sri Lanka's endemic flora and fauna — lowland endemics and mixed-species feeding flocks. Overnight at Sinharaja.

itinerary.title: The South Coast
itinerary.description: Mirissa is one of the most beautiful and widest beaches in Sri Lanka, and has become a well-known place for blue whale watching. Overnight at Mirissa.

_note: Reconstructed from the source site's two-week page (single.html). Two corrections were needed: the original repeated the Udawatta Kele / Kithulgala block as both day 04 and day 05 (merged here into 04–05), and the day 12–13 Sinharaja block carried the Udawalawe text by a copy-paste error — the Sinharaja description and species list here are the operator's own, taken from the 10-day page's Sinharaja section. Please confirm both with Nandana.
